source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: An epidemiologic analysis of adolescent and adult NF1 (n=2,108) and adult glioma (n=489) found a 20-100-fold increased risk, versus US rates, of malignant glioma including glioblastoma multiforme.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 49 Gutmann 2002 PMID 12221173. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 49
